limits: One native cell per component; all other cells remain unchecked.
This does not exhaustively discover raster-only gaps outside retained components.
Owned-cell discrepancies are separated from projection/interpolation effects.
All original blocked tiles and measurement failures remain unresolved.
Nearby IDs are inherited diagnostics; only pilot current contacts are extracted.
Selected current footprints are derived atlas data, not native-provider approval.
Point contacts and every positive-area numerical intersection are retained as flags.
Frozen water-pilot source, date, encoding and registration limits remain unchanged.
No source-backed boundary repair, administrative assignment, release or deployment.
Original GitHub API issue snapshots are protocol evidence, not geographic sources or research-worker approval.
Coordinated follow-ups are staged investigations, not completed native source-backed repairs.

methods.description: Immutable whole original native grid integrity and one-cell-per-retained-component diagnostic; separate native vs app-projected edge interpretation; exact selected current-footprint pilot contacts and retained original issue-member snapshots. No source-backed factual approval.
methods.units: Native grid cell/index and diagnostic counts; longitude then latitude EPSG4326; app Mercator vertices; no new physical area or distance measurements.

metrics.scope: Frozen diagnostic at stated registry-input commit against separately pinned reference geography; one representative native cell per component, all other cells unchecked. Counts are not confirmed defect totals.
